covers: Causes of floods: unusually heavy rain, environmental factors (farming, settlement, fires, loss of vegetation) and earthquakes (tsunamis)
Effects of floods: injury and loss of life, disease, displacement, soil erosion, damage to fields, buildings and infrastructure
